title: A member never hears from the app that a personal training session was booked or cancelled for them
what: The desk or a trainer books a personal training session for a member on the Trainers page, or cancels one. Only the admin app ever reads these bookings. The member app shows no booked sessions, and no phone notice is sent for a booking or a cancellation, so the member learns about it only if someone calls or WhatsApps them by hand. A cancelled session can mean a member turns up for a trainer who is not there.
expected: A booked or cancelled session reaches the member: shown in the member app, or a phone notice, or at least a ready WhatsApp line offered to the desk after Book and Cancel.
who: members with personal training, and the desk
fix_line: Send the member a phone notice (or offer the desk a ready WhatsApp line) when a session is booked or cancelled

title: Once a GST number is saved, the collections export for the accountant still has no GST split
what: With a GST number in Settings, every printed receipt splits the amount into taxable value, CGST and SGST. The Collections export to Excel, which the owner hands to the accountant for the GST return, keeps only the full amount per receipt. The accountant has to work the tax out again for every row, and may use the wrong rate for receipts from before the rate change.
expected: When the gym has a GST number, the collections export carries the same taxable value, CGST and SGST that each receipt prints.
fix_line: Add taxable value, CGST and SGST columns to the collections export when the gym has a GST number

title: The gym's web page and its AI helper never mention the free trial the owner switched on
what: The owner can switch on a free trial for new people (1, 3 or 7 days) in Settings. Only the join form reads it. The gym's own web page says nothing about it, and the AI helper on that page is not told about it, so a visitor who asks 'can I try first?' gets 'I will ask the gym', and the helper still says joining means paying at the gym.
expected: When the free trial is on, the web page shows 'Try free for N days' and the AI helper's facts include it.
who: visitors of the web page, and owners
how_often: every visit while the trial is on
fix_line: Pass the trial days to the web page and to the AI helper facts
